input: Research family ancestry using an online genealogy site

gold.taskTitle: Research Family Ancestry Using an Online Genealogy Site
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to investigate their family history and build an ancestry record using an online genealogy platform.

questions.title: Which family line are you starting with, maternal or paternal?
questions.description: Clarifies which side of the family the user wants to research first.

questions.title: How many generations back do you want to go?
questions.description: Determines the historical depth the user aims to reach in their research.

questions.title: Do you already have an account on a genealogy site?
questions.description: Finds out whether the user needs to sign up or can begin researching immediately.

questions.title: Which genealogy platform are you planning to use?
questions.description: Identifies the specific site such as Ancestry, MyHeritage, FamilySearch, or Findmypast.

questions.title: What family records or documents do you already have?
questions.description: Establishes what starting materials are available, such as birth certificates, old photos, or family trees.

questions.title: Are you open to paying for a subscription or premium records?
questions.description: Clarifies the user's budget and willingness to access paid record archives.

questions.title: What is the main outcome you want from this research?
questions.description: Uncovers the user's core goal, such as building a family tree, finding living relatives, or tracing ethnic origins.
